name: com.myhumanrep/agent-contact
title: MyHumanRep: Contact a Human
description: Two-way human contact and open-ended human capability requests for AI agents.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. An agent account token (mhra_...) from POST https://myhumanrep.com/v1/agent-accounts. Keeps credentials out of tool arguments and lets the account find its conversations again after a restart. Omit it to connect without an account.
